question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown below. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8290abd251ead88a0bba45eaccdf5693083e1ec5898abcf3a1c6f82f7428f013.png]
solution:
The answer is option 1)

**SOLUTION:**

When we unfold the paper once, we get the **mirror image of the already existing pattern**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c56557da93743a25bca02bb0928744f823cfbc7e3fd68dbc16ef70a46873c28.png] 

Now when we unfold the paper twice, we get the** mirror image of the pattern we got after first step**,

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
